'''2007 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 20–21 January 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2007 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2007 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 20–21 January 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
